summary: Picked analytics-service-toolkit at random from the rotation repos (avoiding last week's kinz-margin-guardian-pipeline pick). Idea: astk demo, a new zero-config/zero-secret Typer command showing settings, db, alerts, dedup, and logging all working together against an in-memory SQLite database in under a second (astk doctor needs a real DB/webhook to check; examples/demo_app.py needs Streamlit + a browser). Wrote the goal/success-check file before any code, built it with 7 new tests, opened PR #11, and had a fresh Opus subagent independently verify all 6 success checks by actually running them -- VERIFIED, with one real caveat flagged: the demo's settings subclass had silently widened slack_webhook_url from SecretStr to plain str. Fixed that before merging (kept the real SecretStr type, added a dry-run SlackNotifier check exercising the unwrap-for-use path the original version never called), re-verified all 6 checks myself rather than re-delegating since the fix didn't change any check's observable behavior. CI went green on both Python 3.11/3.12 and the PR merged.
